claims.claim: The human development approach, developed by economist Mahbub ul Haq and anchored in Amartya Sen's capability work, was introduced in the first UN Human Development Report in 1990 to shift focus from the richness of the economy to the richness of human life.

The HDI has three dimensions: a long and healthy life (life expectancy at birth), knowledge (expected years of schooling and mean years of schooling), and a decent standard of living (GNI per capita).

Each HDI indicator is rescaled to a 0-1 dimension index using fixed goalposts (life expectancy 20-85 years; expected schooling 0-18; mean schooling 0-15; GNI per capita $100-$75,000 in 2017 PPP dollars, entered as a logarithm), and the three dimension indices are combined using their geometric mean.
UNDP groups countries into four categories using fixed HDI cutoffs: low (below 0.550), medium (0.550-0.699), high (0.700-0.799), and very high (0.800 and above).

In the 2023/24 Human Development Report (released March 2024, based on 2022 data), the global HDI reached a record high of about 0.74 after pandemic-era declines; Switzerland, Norway, and Iceland recorded the highest values while the Central African Republic, South Sudan, and Somalia recorded the lowest.

The HDI uses national averages and does not capture within-country inequality; the inequality-adjusted HDI (IHDI) discounts each dimension for its inequality and equals the HDI only when there is no inequality.
The Gender Inequality Index (GII) measures loss in human development from gender inequality across three dimensions: reproductive health, empowerment, and the labour market.

The global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI), produced by UNDP with the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative, counts overlapping household-level deprivations across health, education, and standard of living to identify who is multidimensionally poor.

A worked HDI calculation with life expectancy 75, expected schooling 14, mean schooling 9, and GNI per capita $20,000 yields dimension indices of about 0.846, 0.689, and 0.800 and an HDI of about 0.776 by geometric mean (vs 0.779 by arithmetic mean).
